content.short: HypeRPC provides low-latency RPC and archival node infrastructure dedicated to Hyperliquid.
content.description: HypeRPC provides dedicated RPC endpoints and real-time data APIs built only for Hyperliquid, with validator-peered infrastructure in Japan and Europe. Dedicated nodes give isolated resources, deterministic latency and higher rate limits than the public API, which matters for trading bots and liquidation systems. It claims 99.99 percent uptime, and the business has been acquired by HyperDash.
content.meta: HypeRPC is a dedicated Hyperliquid RPC provider offering low-latency and archival endpoints.
